content.content: When the deccy CLI opens a draft, the deccy CLI shall write the draft's registry record without making an operation of it: the write appends no operation marker, is never bracketed, and gives undo and redo no unit of their own to step.
content.rationale:
The requirement says what opening a draft does to the registry and nothing more. Its trigger and its object come from owyntkvw: the thing opening writes is a record, a registry-local object keyed by its own generated handle and naming its target node, edit and workspace by reference, so the write lands outside the node space the graph lists and attributes and is neither a node document nor a change. That is what makes the first clause a statement about the kind of thing being written rather than a restriction imposed on a node or a change, and the later clauses then follow from it instead of accumulating beside it.

The remaining clauses are qvkuluyw's boundary read onto that moment. qvkuluyw settles that the three forms the vocabulary names are the whole of the operation set and that only they bracket, and that a registry write is none of the three; it also settles that undo and redo step whole operations. Stated here, that is: the write at opening makes no operation, appends no marker, is never bracketed, and leaves undo and redo no unit of their own. Each clause is a facet of the same cut, not a new rule: there is no fourth form the write could take, so nothing else has to be excluded; the marker orders and steps the operations the vocabulary holds, so a write outside that set has nothing to append; and a thing that is not an operation offers the undo and redo stack no unit to reverse. No clause here decides the boundary again, and no clause could stand if the others were dropped.

The commitment is scoped to opening. The landing half of qvkuluyw, the record update riding inside the recording that landing already is, is not stated, narrowed or extended here; this node says only that the registry write an opening performs is no operation, no bracket and no undoable unit. What a landing does to the record is the next layer's, and nothing here forecloses it.
